title: Secret Directive: Public Discussion Describes Confidential Government UAP Reporting Procedures
author: Baptiste Friscourt
summary: Peter Skafish described an alleged classified executive directive and multiple government reporting paths for UAP-related information. The public evidence is the recorded discussion; the directive itself is not public or independently authenticated.

image.alt: Editorial illustration of military, intelligence and law-enforcement reporting paths converging on a secure government office, with a sealed directive folder and recorded-discussion waveform.
image.caption: GreyAlien editorial illustration of the procedures described in the public discussion—not an image of the classified directive.

editorialNotes.imageRequirement: Companion image required for every newly ingested UAP news article unless explicitly waived.
